newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Dec department store sales fall on month.
newsitem.headline: Canada Dec department store sales fall on month.

text.p: Canadian department stores sales fell a seasonally adjusted 1.0 percent in December from November to C$1.24 billion, Statistics Canada said on Friday.
In unadjusted data, year-over-year sales in December rose 4.0 percent to C$2.27 billion.
Sales in calendar 1996 rose 4.4 percent to C$14.45 billion from 1995.

Sales during the Christmas shopping season, November and December, rose 7.8 percent from the same period in 1995. Sales during the last two months of the year account for 27 percent of total annual sales.
Sales at major stores fell 0.4 percent in 1996 from 1995, the fourth consecutive annual decline.
Consumer spending in the discount stores rose 8.6 percent in 1996 from 1995.
(For more information from Statistics Canada, contact Mary Beth Garneau, Retail Trade Section, Industry Division, 613-951-9824.)
